hook.name: SteadyHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for fixed-fee launch pools (Beam at 1%, Prism at creator-chosen rate up to 5%). The hook collects fees on the stock (currency0) side of every swap and distributes them three ways: a fixed 30% platform share, a creator share split among up to three recipients, and a remainder to token holders via a FeeDistributor.
